Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 3
, Reason for Mistake: In Step 3, the Planner incorrectly interpreted the "Peter Finch" entry found on the Vivien Leigh Wikipedia page as a marriage. The text clearly indicated it was a "relationship" (likely a cohabitation or partnership) and not a legal marriage. Furthermore, the Planner made a logical contradiction by stating the marriage associated with the Gone with the Wind era was Peter Finch (1950–1959), which is historically incorrect (she was married to Laurence Olivier during that time) and inconsistent with the data just extracted from the same page. This erroneous conclusion led to a redundant and confused search cycle to "prove" a false fact.
